Japan's Economy Shows Faster Growth and Wage Increases

Japan's economy experienced faster growth in the second quarter than initially reported, with capital expenditure showing a slight improvement. Concurrently, nominal wages in July saw their largest increase since 1997, rising by 4.7% compared to the previous year. This economic data, including a revised 4% wage increase in June, is being monitored by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) and supports the possibility of future interest rate hikes.
